title: Component changelog (draft)
description: Per-component changelog generated by `design-data changelog` and committed as changelog/<component>.json. Releases are append-only. The component version is derived from the entries (see spec/component-changelog.md); it is never authored.

component.description: Component name, the `name` of its component file.

baseline.description: Present when the component already existed before the first recorded release; its version is the starting 1.0.0.

releases.description: Oldest first. A release already recorded is never rewritten.

release.description: The package release the changes shipped in, e.g. a package version. `unreleased` holds changes not yet in a release; the next release takes them over.

version.description: Component semver after this release. 1.0.0 at the component's first release.

bump.description: The highest bump among the entries; absent for the first release.

commit.description: Dataset commit the release was taken at.

commits.description: The changes of each commit in the release, oldest first.

class.description: visual: how the component looks or behaves (values, bindings, recipes). api: options, option values, states, anatomy, relationships present or removed, lifecycle. documentation: descriptions, document blocks, rationale. Metadata-class changes (legacy keys, ids, ordering, implementations, spec bookkeeping) are not entries; see commitChanges.metadata.

source.description: The PR number from the squash subject (#NNN), otherwise the commit sha and subject.

path.description: Dot path of the changed field.

kind.description: A token entry is a Values updated change; a relationship entry is a Bindings changed change.

bump.description: Semver bump this entry implies. major: an option, option value, state, anatomy part, slot or relationship removed; an option, state, anatomy part or slot renamed; an option type changed; the component deprecated or removed. minor: anything added, including a recipe. patch: everything else.

indirect.description: True when a bound token's own record is unchanged but its alias-resolved value changed.

reachedBy.description: Set when the component reaches the changed token only through its tokenBindings (by token name), not through a relationship. Absent for relationship-reached and component-owned changes.

contexts.description: Relationship contexts (spec-sheet block titles) the change appears under.

record.description: Record uuid, or a component-relative path such as options/size/values/xl.

before.description: Added and removed records: the bound token or value for relationships and tokens, the record otherwise.

via.description: Indirect entries: uuids of the aliased tokens whose own record changed.

rationale.description: The record's own rationale, read where it exists. Not required.

entries.description: Listed changes (visual, api, documentation). Each is written on one line in the committed file.

metadata.description: Metadata-class changes of the commit, counted rather than listed. fields are the changed field paths; a record added or removed is named `<kind> <change>`, e.g. `implementation added`.
